content:
Dear Leaners,

I have reached a milestone with the project about the (mostly algebraic) theory of (mostly discrete) optimization, so I created a release today:
https://github.com/madvorak/vcsp/tree/v3.0.0

I originally planned to keep the code only transiently in my repo, until the code gets to Mathlib; however, given the state of my largest PR, it is probably going to stay as a standalone project forever. Therefore, if you want to build anything on top of the VCSP beyond the basic definitions, which found their way to Mathlib, I suggest you import my project directly. Currently I am on Lean v4.8.0-rc1 and, if anybody happens to be interested in my project, I can promise I will keep upgrading (to new Mathlib) a version that has no breaking changes with respect to VCSP v3.0.0 at least until 2024-11-15.
Can you open a discussion thread for this on #general please?
